en: The image depicts a historical urban public square with an obelisk-like monument at its center, surrounded by a metal fence and neatly trimmed trees and shrubs. The square is bordered by cobblestone streets and early-20th-century European-style buildings. Visible on one building is a large painted advertisement for 'Fahrrad-Zubehörteile Reimh. Wendt.', indicating a bicycle and accessories shop.
